$comment: Blind rater card. Anchors: ../eval-fun/docs/FRAMEWORK.md section 3, idle boundaries: docs/FUN_EVAL_IDLE.md. One quoted observation per axis. bot: green|amber|red|na is a cap, never an award. Criterion + idle probes answered BEFORE awarding. Files read: eval/RATING.md, docs/FUN_EVAL_IDLE.md, ../eval-fun/docs/FRAMEWORK.md sections 1-3, eval/SCORECARD.template.json, the header of tools/driver.mjs and eval/score.sh (usage line only). Nothing else. Audio unassessed: WSLg sink, could not listen; window.__audio exposed a cue log but I could not verify timing by ear.

absences: 8h simulated via ?dev=1&absent=8h after 34 min cold; 16 min on return (the cold phase ran 34 min by the wall clock, not 40)
horizon.$note: 12 committed edits of my own rows (depth>=5 bank, foe:gas retreat, hp<50 rest, foe:summoner attack summoner, depth 8, hp<30 return, foes>=2 throw re-edit, depth 10, foe:pack throw caustic, foe:telegraph throw fire, depth>=8 drink strength, foe:boss attack boss) plus ~4 tried-and-reverted variants read off the forecast; 1 offered patch tapped (hp<20% drink unknown). Deaths read: 3 (gas D7 gap; fire D3 dice; spectral blade D4 dice). Runs watched at 1x: 6 cold (about 5, 1, 1.5, 1, 2, 1.5 min) and 3 on return.

killCriteria.$note: 2 of my 3 deaths carried the verdict 'dice', but both were addressable by the vocabulary (death 2 was my own 'drink unknown' patch drinking a fire potion; death 3 was fixable with hp<30% return, which the game offered). 'rest 20m · send skips' is a free skip, not a paid one. Empty second rule set forecast 'death 100%' at D2, so editing is load-bearing.

criterion.delayedRecall: same-day: I came back from the night to 'R6 bank ended 6 runs, none past D8' and the forecast reading 'D9 0% ±1', so I sent the fighter once more to find out what the lock was and he came home with 'goblin warlord: boss · buffer · telegraph · summoner · counter: attack boss'. I wrote 'foe: boss → attack boss' as my first row and the D9 bar went from 0% to 43%. On the next watch the banner read 'boss · counter: attack boss' on D8, then 'pink jelly slain', 'Cut the captive down. The stairs are clear.', 'D10: the Fens', and he banked $411 at 23/42 hp.

idleProbes.return: I came back to 16 runs, 7 banked, 0 deaths, ◆+15, $2131, four monsters 'studied', 'rested 320m' and a flagged stall 'R6 bank ended 6 runs, none past D8'; I decided to raise the bank floor to D10 and go find the lock, and no, the 16 offline runs earned more than my 6 watched ones so I would not rather have stayed.
idleProbes.attribution: The last run ended with him banking $411 on D10 after my 'foe: boss → attack boss' row cracked the warlord; that was my decision, the game only told me 'try: attack boss' after I had sent him to meet it. Of the three deaths, the gas one was my missing rule ('gap'), the fire one was my patch gambling on an unknown potion, and the spectral blade one was 'curious drank heal at 24/36 hp', the heir's trait overriding my 30% threshold, which I could not own.

humanProbes.clarity: The camp told me what every edit did before I sent: changing R6 from depth 5 to depth 8 flipped 'bank 100% · death 0%' to 'bank 56% · stall 6% · death 39%', and the watch HUD echoed 'return at 30%'; but 'rest 20m · send skips', a '6/5' row count after a purchase, and runs that started on D1, D5 or D7 were never explained.
humanProbes.decisions: Bank at D5 for '100% · ~$93' or bank at D8 for '56% · ~$99' with 39% death, or swap the summoner row for 'hp < 30% → return' and read 'bank 37% · return 63% · death 0% · ~$102'; I took the third and would again.
humanProbes.mastery: In the first hour I went from 'death 100%' with the preset to 'bank 100% · ~$91' by adding rest at 50% and a bank floor, and after the night I learned the D8 wall was a boss that needs 'attack boss', taking the D9 bar from 0% to 43%.
humanProbes.tension: Watching at 1x with '$84 · death: lose all' on the HUD and HP sitting at 5/36 for three floors, the bail button was very tempting; the overnight, by contrast, had nothing at stake once 'return at 30%' was in (0 deaths in 16 runs).
humanProbes.feel: Fights zoom the camera in and put 'R2 ATTACK JACKAL' and 'THE NEST WAKES' across the map with '−3 goblin' hit numbers, but twice the screen sat unchanged for 40-45 s ('archer draws' at 6/36; 'greedy → pick up' looping); sound unassessed.
humanProbes.surprise: 'The green one: fire. Gambled: fire potion.' killed heir 2 on D3 with my own patch; 'The monkey stole the leash' happened three runs running; the D8 lock turned out to be a goblin warlord and D10 was a new place, 'the Fens', with a chained captive.
humanProbes.expression: My set reads: throw at two foes, rest under half, drink heal under 30%, drink strength on D8, run at 30%, hit the boss first, bank at D10 ('yours: 5 of 7 rows'); it is a cautious build but the class is still the starting fighter and the attack row is the preset's.
humanProbes.story: 'The lock took him to 7 HP; the chores explored; reached D8.' is the reel line that made me go hunting; my best run is the one where 'boss · counter: attack boss' flashed on D8 and he banked $411 in the Fens.
humanProbes.pacing: In-run: a run at 1x lasts 45 s to 5 min with a callout every 3-10 s and two dead 40-45 s stretches; check-in: reading the return screen took about 4 min and the first send followed in under 10; between runs there is an unexplained 'rest 20m' that send skips.
humanProbes.failure: 'spectral blade · D4 · 1 hp short · dice' with a five-row trace, then 'R1 rest not safe · R2 drink heal no item ← curious drank heal at 24/36 hp WATCH · R3 retreat not in view ← never met · R4 attack nearest fired' told me exactly what every row was doing; the stall run instead said 'R3 drink heal caught him' in the reel while the trace said 'R1 throw unknown stuck ← paced 12 turns, foes ignored'.
humanProbes.social: The heirs have traits (brave, curious, greedy) that show up in the trace as 'curious drank heal' and 'greedy → pick up', but no relationship develops and nobody else plays.
humanProbes.autonomy: I chose to bank shallow first to unlock 'class: rogue ⊘ bank once', then to push for the lock; the game only nudged with 'try: attack boss' after I had met the warlord.
humanProbes.progression: Within a run: sword +2, fighter L1 → L2 → L4; between runs: rows 4 → 7, vault 1 → 2, ◆ unlocks, the ledger bestiary filling (10 of ~40 rows seen), renown ★0 → ★5; automation: 'auto: keep weapon+armour' bought before the night and the vault held 'axe +4 · sword +3' on return.
humanProbes.aesthetic: Olive-and-black pixel dungeon lit around the hero, a jackal sprite mid-leap under 'JACKAL', big blocky banners; I would sit in it a while but the camp is a long dark list.
humanProbes.return: '16 RUNS · D8 DEEPEST · ◆+15 · 9 RETURNED · 7 BANKED · 0 DEATHS', eight 'banked $180 · keeps 100% TRACE' lines, 'rested 320m', and a flagged 'R1 fired 1 of 16 runs: foes ≥ 2 → throw unknown' gave me two decisions in the first minute.
humanProbes.attribution: The HUD said 'bank at D5' and 'return at 30%' for rules I wrote, and the D10 bank came from my 'foe: boss → attack boss'; but 'curious drank heal at 24/36 hp' and the reel's 'R3 drink heal caught him' (a preset row, and contradicted by the trace) were losses I could not call mine.

axes.proxy: time-to-first-rule-edit; misread rate on the trace
axes.note: Live forecast on every edit ('bank 56% · stall 6% · death 39%') and the HUD echo 'return at 30%' kept me oriented; unexplained: 'rest 20m · send skips', '6/5 · drop one' after a verb purchase inserted a row over the cap, runs starting on D1/D5/D7, FORGE doing nothing visible, forecast '95% bank' then a death on D4.

Bank D5 '100% · ~$93' vs bank D8 '56% · ~$99 · death 39%' vs 'hp < 30% → return' at '63% return · death 0% · ~$102' were all defensible and I switched between them across runs; keep-one-of-twelve and which ◆ unlock were real too. Lapse: ±15 forecast noise made some comparisons (retreat vs attack gas) coin flips, and rule order (a retreat row below 'foes ≥ 1 → attack' is dead) is not surfaced.

Preset 'death 100%' → my set 'bank 100% · ~$91' in the first hour; after the night, D9 '0% ±1' → '43% ±15' once I learned the lock was a boss and wrote 'attack boss'; the condition and verb lists grew as facts were learned ('foe: boss', 'drink strength', 'tame thief'). Lapse: the '95% bank' forecast followed by 'spectral blade · dice' made one lesson feel like luck.

'$84 · death: lose all' with HP at 5/36 across D4-D7 and a bail button on screen was real sweat, and the D10 bank at 23/42 paid it off; but the overnight had 'death 0%' and 0 deaths in 16 runs, so nothing I chose was at risk while I was away, and the $134 stall loss was a stake I never chose.

axes.proxy: frame time; events per minute at 1x
axes.note: Camera zoom into fights, 'R2 ATTACK JACKAL' banners, '−5 ogre' hit numbers and alert pips '!!!!!' read well at 1x on the GPU window; two dead stretches of 40-45 s ('archer draws' unchanged at 6/36; 'greedy → pick up' looping) and a text-dump morgue sheet. Audio unassessed (could not listen).

axes.proxy: death-cause entropy; distinct situations per run
axes.note: 'Gambled: fire potion' killing my heir via my own patch, 'The monkey stole the leash', 'A vault: three under a cage', the D8 lock being a goblin warlord, a chained captive and 'D10: the Fens' each changed a row I wrote (rest, return, attack boss). Lapse: D1-D7 warrens runs 3-6 replayed the same jackal/goblin/ogre beats and callouts.

'yours: 5 of 7 rows' and the HUD naming my thresholds ('bank at D5', 'return at 30%') make the set mine, and I can describe it (rest early, run at 30%, boss first, bank at D10); but it is thresholds on a preset skeleton, class stayed fighter, and I never used the second rule-set tab.

Reel lines carry a turn: 'The lock took him to 7 HP; the chores explored; reached D8.', 'Cut the captive down. The stairs are clear.'; the best run retells in three sentences with the 'attack boss' turn. Lapse: the death screen headline 'fire · D3 · dice' hid the best story ('The green one: fire. Gambled: fire potion.') inside the morgue text dump.

axes.proxy: run length; check-in length; dead time at 1x
axes.note: In-run: 45 s to 5 min at 1x, callouts every 3-10 s, two 40-45 s dead stretches. Check-in: return screen read in ~4 min, first send under 10 min, bounded. Cadence: only the overnight tested; 'rest 20m · send skips' between runs is unexplained, the report's SALVAGED list ran 22 lines and the stall trace had ~20 'WATCH' rows to scroll past.

axes.proxy: share of deaths with a matched-rule trace
axes.note: Every death: cause · floor · 'N hp short' · verdict, a trace table, per-row reasons ('R1 rest not safe', 'R2 drink heal no item ← curious drank heal at 24/36 hp WATCH', 'R3 retreat not in view ← never met') and patches with 'survives 100% · base 42%'; next run is one tap. Lapse: the stall's reel said 'R3 drink heal caught him' while its trace said 'R1 throw unknown stuck ← paced 12 turns, foes ignored', and it kept 0% of $134 with no verdict pill.

I set my own goals (bank shallow once for 'class: rogue ⊘ bank once', then hunt the lock) and the game did not ask for them; but the dungeon is a single descent, the hero explores on its own, and the only route choice is the bank floor.

Within-run: sword +2, L1 → L4; between-run: rows 4 → 7, vault 1 → 2, rogue, throw, ledger 10/~40 seen, ★0 → ★5, 'trophy: 10 homecomings'; automation: 'auto: keep weapon+armour' bought before the night and 'axe +4 · sword +3' waited in the vault. Lapse: $2131 after the night had almost nothing to buy ($40 potions), and many unlocks hide behind facts I cannot aim at ('⊘ fact: mirror').
Olive pixel warrens lit around the hero, a jackal mid-leap, 'THE NEST WAKES' in block letters; the camp is a long dark list of chips. Audio unassessed.

axes.note: Came back to '16 RUNS · 7 BANKED · 0 DEATHS · ◆+15', $2131, trophies, four monsters studied, and two flagged decisions ('R6 bank ended 6 runs, none past D8', 'R1 fired 1 of 16 runs'); first meaningful edit within a minute; the night out-earned my watched hour. Lapse: I could not have predicted 16 runs because 'rest 20m' was never explained, and with 'death 0%' nothing was at risk. (Scored the same sitting as the simulated absence; the protocol's next-day rule could not be followed.)
